0.content:
## Nexus V2
Arriba, el estado de los últimos 30 minutos según las alertas de umbral fijo y el % de error. Abajo, el detalle del rango elegido. Cluster filtra todo; Servicio y Canal, las secciones 1, 2 y 5.

1.title: ESTADO (últimos 30 min)
1.query:
timeseries r = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses, default: 0), by: { cluster, outcome }, from: now()-32m, to: now()-2m
| fieldsAdd n = arraySum(r)
| summarize responses = sum(n), errors = sum(if(outcome == "error", n, else: 0)), by: { cluster }
| fieldsAdd pct_error = round(100.0 * errors / responses, decimals: 2)
| fieldsAdd rank = if(responses >= 20 and pct_error >= 10, 2, else: if(responses >= 20 and pct_error >= 5, 1, else: 0))
| fields alert_id = 0, cluster, rank, responses, pct_error,
    text = if(rank > 0, concat("% error en 30 min: ", toString(pct_error), "% contra umbral ",
                               if(rank == 2, "10", else: "5"), "%, "))
| append [
    timeseries total = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m, from: now()-32m, to: now()-2m
    | join [
        timeseries errors = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses, default: 0), by: { cluster },
            filter: outcome == "error", interval: 1m, from: now()-32m, to: now()-2m
      ], on: { cluster }, fields: { errors }
    | fieldsAdd error_pct = if(total[] > 10, 100.0 * errors[] / total[], else: 0.0)
    | fieldsKeep timeframe, interval, cluster, error_pct
    | fieldsAdd above = if(error_pct[] > 5, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd peak = arrayMax(error_pct),
        rank = if(arrayLast(firing) == 1, 2, else: if(arraySum(firing) > 0, 1, else: 0))
    | fields alert_id = 1, cluster, rank,
        text = if(rank > 0, concat("% error", if(rank == 2, " disparando", else: " disparó y se recuperó"),
                                   ": pico ", toString(round(peak, decimals: 1)), "% contra umbral 5%, "))
  ]
| append [
    timeseries timeouts = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.timeouts, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m, from: now()-32m, to: now()-2m
    | fieldsAdd above = if(timeouts[] > 2, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd peak = arrayMax(timeouts),
        rank = if(arrayLast(firing) == 1, 2, else: if(arraySum(firing) > 0, 1, else: 0))
    | fields alert_id = 2, cluster, rank,
        text = if(rank > 0, concat("Timeouts 504", if(rank == 2, " disparando", else: " disparó y se recuperó"),
                                   ": pico ", toString(toLong(peak)), " por minuto contra umbral 2 por minuto, "))
  ]
| append [
    timeseries mapping_errors = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.mapping_errors, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m, from: now()-32m, to: now()-2m
    | fieldsAdd above = if(mapping_errors[] > 2, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd peak = arrayMax(mapping_errors),
        rank = if(arrayLast(firing) == 1, 2, else: if(arraySum(firing) > 0, 1, else: 0))
    | fields alert_id = 3, cluster, rank,
        text = if(rank > 0, concat("Errores de mapeo", if(rank == 2, " disparando", else: " disparó y se recuperó"),
                                   ": pico ", toString(toLong(peak)), " por minuto contra umbral 2 por minuto, "))
  ]

    timeseries backend_5xx = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses, default: 0), by: { cluster },
        filter: startsWith(http_code, "5"), interval: 1m, from: now()-32m, to: now()-2m
    | fieldsAdd above = if(backend_5xx[] > 1, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd peak = arrayMax(backend_5xx),
        rank = if(arrayLast(firing) == 1, 2, else: if(arraySum(firing) > 0, 1, else: 0))
    | fields alert_id = 4, cluster, rank,
        text = if(rank > 0, concat("5xx del backend", if(rank == 2, " disparando", else: " disparó y se recuperó"),
                                   ": pico ", toString(toLong(peak)), " por minuto contra umbral 1 por minuto, "))
  ]
| append [
    timeseries total = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m, from: now()-32m, to: now()-2m
    | join [
        timeseries rejected = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses, default: 0), by: { cluster },
            filter: acceptance == "M", interval: 1m, from: now()-32m, to: now()-2m
      ], on: { cluster }, fields: { rejected }
    | fieldsAdd rejection_pct = if(total[] > 10, 100.0 * rejected[] / total[], else: 0.0)
    | fieldsKeep timeframe, interval, cluster, rejection_pct

                                   ": pico ", toString(round(peak, decimals: 1)), "% contra umbral 40%, "))
  ]
| append [
    timeseries total = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.backend_calls, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m, from: now()-32m, to: now()-2m
    | join [
        timeseries slow = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.backend_calls, default: 0), by: { cluster },
            filter: in(latency_bucket, array("1-5s", "5s+")), interval: 1m, from: now()-32m, to: now()-2m

    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd peak = arrayMax(slow_pct),
        rank = if(arrayLast(firing) == 1, 2, else: if(arraySum(firing) > 0, 1, else: 0))
    | fields alert_id = 7, cluster, rank,

                                   ": pico ", toString(round(peak, decimals: 1)), "% contra umbral 5%, "))
  ]
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster))
| summarize rank = max(rank), by: { cluster }
| summarize clusters = count(), mal = countIf(rank == 2), revisar = countIf(rank == 1)
| fields estado = if(clusters == 0, "SIN DATOS", else: if(mal > 0, "MAL", else: if(revisar > 0, "REVISAR", else: "BIEN")))
| fieldsRename `Estado` = estado
1.description: MAL: una alerta disparando ahora o 10% de error o más en 30 min. REVISAR: una alerta disparó y se recuperó, o entre 5% y 10% de error. Detalle en la tabla de abajo

35.title: ALERTAS DE UMBRAL FIJO: MINUTOS SOBRE EL UMBRAL

| join [

| fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
| fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
| fields alert = "1. % error real del adaptador (umbral 5%)", cluster,
    max_value = arrayMax(error_pct), minutes_above = arraySum(above), minutes_firing = arraySum(firing)

    timeseries timeouts = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.timeouts, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m

    | fields alert = "2. Timeouts 504 (umbral 2 por minuto)", cluster,

  ]
| append [
    timeseries mapping_errors = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.mapping_errors, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
    | fieldsAdd above = if(mapping_errors[] > 2, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fields alert = "3. Errores de mapeo (umbral 2 por minuto)", cluster,
        max_value = arrayMax(mapping_errors), minutes_above = arraySum(above), minutes_firing = arraySum(firing)
  ]
| append [
    timeseries backend_5xx = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.responses, default: 0), by: { cluster },
        filter: startsWith(http_code, "5"), interval: 1m
    | fieldsAdd above = if(backend_5xx[] > 1, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fields alert = "4. 5xx del backend (umbral 1 por minuto)", cluster,
        max_value = arrayMax(backend_5xx), minutes_above = arraySum(above), minutes_firing = arraySum(firing)
  ]
| append [
    timeseries total = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
    | join [
        timeseries rejected = sum(custom.nexus.log.mngr.soap_responses, default: 0), by: { cluster },
            filter: acceptance == "M", interval: 1m
      ], on: { cluster }, fields: { rejected }
    | fieldsAdd rejection_pct = if(total[] > 10, 100.0 * rejected[] / total[], else: 0.0)
    | fieldsKeep timeframe, interval, cluster, rejection_pct
    | fieldsAdd above = if(rejection_pct[] > 40, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fields alert = "5. % respuestas M al canal (umbral 40%)", cluster,
        max_value = arrayMax(rejection_pct), minutes_above = arraySum(above), minutes_firing = arraySum(firing)
  ]
| append [
    timeseries total = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.backend_calls, default: 0), by: { cluster }, interval: 1m
    | join [
        timeseries slow = sum(custom.nexus.log.adapter.backend_calls, default: 0), by: { cluster },
            filter: in(latency_bucket, array("1-5s", "5s+")), interval: 1m
      ], on: { cluster }, fields: { slow }
    | fieldsAdd slow_pct = if(total[] > 10, 100.0 * slow[] / total[], else: 0.0)
    | fieldsKeep timeframe, interval, cluster, slow_pct
    | fieldsAdd above = if(slow_pct[] > 5, 1, else: 0)
    | fieldsAdd win5 = arrayMovingSum(above, 5)
    | fieldsAdd firing = if(win5[] >= 3, 1, else: 0)
    | fields alert = "7. % llamadas al backend de más de 1 s (umbral 5%)", cluster,
        max_value = arrayMax(slow_pct), minutes_above = arraySum(above), minutes_firing = arraySum(firing)
  ]
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(cluster, $Cluster)) and minutes_above > 0
| sort minutes_firing desc, minutes_above desc
| fieldsRename `Alerta` = alert, `Cluster` = cluster, `Valor máximo` = max_value, `Minutos sobre el umbral` = minutes_above, `Minutos disparando` = minutes_firing

51.title: TRANSACCIONES CON ERROR EN EL TIEMPO, POR CAUSA
51.query:
fetch logs
| filter dt.system.bucket == "bck-nexus-error-log"
| filter (nexus.kind == "audit_resp" and nexus.outcome == "error")
    or in(nexus.kind, array("timeout_504", "mapping_error", "technical_error"))
// lines without rquid count as one transaction each
| fieldsAdd trx = coalesce(nexus.rquid, concat("no-rquid-", toString(timestamp)))
| summarize started = min(timestamp), nexus.cluster = takeAny(nexus.cluster),
    nexus.service = takeAny(nexus.service), nexus.channel = takeAny(nexus.channel),
    timeout_lines = countIf(nexus.kind == "timeout_504"), mapping_lines = countIf(nexus.kind == "mapping_error"),
    technical_lines = countIf(nexus.kind == "technical_error"), by: { trx }
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))
| fieldsAdd cause = if(timeout_lines > 0, "Timeout 504", else: if(mapping_lines > 0, "Error de mapeo",
    else: if(technical_lines > 0, "Error técnico", else: "Sin causa en el log")))

54.title: ERRORES DE MAPEO CON EJEMPLO
54.query:

| filter dt.system.bucket == "bck-nexus-error-log" and coalesce(nexus.kind, "") != "soap_resp"
| filter (in("*", $Cluster) or in(nexus.cluster, $Cluster)) and ($Servicio == "*" or nexus.service == $Servicio) and (in("*", $Canal) or in(nexus.channel, $Canal))

| summarize total = count(), example = takeFirst(example), rquid = takeFirst(nexus.rquid),
    by: { nexus.cluster, nexus.service, nexus.channel, nexus.mapping.direction, nexus.mapping.field, nexus.mapping.rule }
| sort total desc
| limit 50
